name: CreateHub
title: Templates/Platform/Create/CreateHub
summary: The Creation Center, where a project starts: the creation header with a single current crumb and a back control to Home, a large page heading whose lead also offers to pick a file or a folder, then two columns side by side from the large breakpoint. On the left, Import from GitHub: a dashed EmptyState with Continue with GitHub until an account is connected, then an account Select with an Add GitHub Account option, a search that also takes a repository URL, and a flush list of repositories with an Import button each, shown as skeleton rows while a scope loads. On the right, Start from Template: a Filter button over a faded ScrollArea holding Recommended framework cards in three columns, then the starter templates, one per kind of resource, and every other framework as two-column cards with the vendor beside the title. Dragging a folder onto the page shows the drop target plotted in ProjectIntake. Built from `PageHeader`, `GlobalHeader`, `Breadcrumb`, `EmptyState`, `Link`, `Select`, `Input`, `Card`, `Item`, `Skeleton`, `ScrollArea` and `Button`.
